name: Design {OS}
tagline: UX, interaction and visual design compiled into a machine-readable handoff.

commands.name: /design-os
commands.does: Open the compiler, read the pinned Blueprint, propose a mode

commands.name: full
commands.does: Run every pass and emit the complete design pack plus the handoff

commands.name: audit
commands.does: Challenge an existing design or shipped UI, emit a repair handoff

commands.name: flow <id>
commands.does: Resolve selected journeys with every edge state named

commands.name: ai-app
commands.does: Compile the AI interaction surface and its visible states

commands.name: stax-fit
commands.does: Decide whether, where and how to use the STAX panel model

commands.name: revision <delta>
commands.does: Update only the impacted IDs and contracts

commands.name: omega-designer intake
commands.does: Validate the Blueprint intake before designing

commands.name: omega-designer handoff
commands.does: Validate the Design Handoff for Stepper

requires_human_approval_for: freezing the Design Handoff, since Stepper plans against it
adopting a navigation shell that changes the product's mental model
accepting a known accessibility failure into a release
specifying a destructive or irreversible user action without local undo
replacing an existing component library or design system
